question: A sport tests every athlete for a drug perhaps 1 in 1,000 uses. The test is right 99% of the time. An athlete tests positive. What is the honest headline?
answer: Among 10,000 athletes, 10 use it and about 10 test positive. But 1% of the other 9,990 — around 100 — test positive too. Roughly nine in ten positives are clean athletes, which is exactly why a second independent test exists.
move: One test on a rare thing is a reason to test again, not a verdict.
trap: Ninety-nine per cent sounds like near-certainty about the person.
